🌿 Spinach + Paneer Roti in Pregnancy

A simple roti that quietly nourishes you and your growing baby.

✅ Iron-rich spinach supports hemoglobin and helps reduce fatigue.
✅ Protein-packed paneer builds your baby’s muscles, tissues, and tiny organs.
✅ Natural folate from spinach supports healthy brain and spine development.
✅ Calcium from paneer strengthens bones and teeth for both mom and baby.
✅ High fiber keeps digestion smooth and reduces constipation during pregnancy.
✅ Steady energy without sugar spikes, perfect for a clean, balanced meal.

It’s like wrapping two superheroes in one warm, soft roti.
Your body gets quiet applause with every bite.

⸻

🌿 1. Iron boost for better energy
Spinach brings a calm army of iron that supports hemoglobin levels and helps prevent tiredness, dizziness, and anemia during pregnancy.

🧀 2. Protein that builds your baby’s world
Paneer adds gentle, easy-to-digest protein that supports your baby’s muscle, bone, and organ development. It also keeps you full without the heaviness.

💚 3. Folate for baby’s brain & spine
Spinach is loaded with natural folate. This nutrient supports healthy neural tube formation and lowers the risk of birth defects.

🦴 4. Calcium for stronger bones & teeth
Paneer slips in a good dose of calcium, supporting your baby’s bone growth and keeping your own bones steady and strong.

🔥 5. High-fiber comfort for digestion
The whole-wheat roti and spinach help reduce constipation, a common pregnancy visitor you never invited.

⚖️ 6. Balanced, steady energy
This combo fuels you without sugar spikes. Perfect for pregnant women managing blood sugar or trying to eat clean and steady through the day.

🧘‍♀️ 7. Gentle on the stomach
No spices that shout, no oil that overwhelms. Just warm, grounded nourishment your body understands.

A wholesome, comforting choice your body understands. 🌾💚
